# The Stoic Reference

> Ask any life question and get sourced Stoic quotes from Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus, and Musonius Rufus, with modern interpretations.

## Pages

- [Home — Ask the Stoics](/): Question search and a daily meditation.
- [Philosophers](/philosophers): The four principal Roman Stoics.
- [Themes](/themes): Stoic teachings organized by subject.
- [Daily Word Search](/wordsearch): A themed Stoic word search, refreshed each day.
- [About](/about): What Stoicism is and how this reference works.

## Philosophers

- [Marcus Aurelius](/philosophers/marcus-aurelius): Roman emperor, author of the Meditations.
- [Seneca](/philosophers/seneca): Statesman and letter-writer.
- [Epictetus](/philosophers/epictetus): Freed slave; teacher of the Discourses and Enchiridion.
- [Musonius Rufus](/philosophers/musonius-rufus): Roman teacher of Epictetus.
